commentary.bulkers: Safe Bulkers announced the sale of their Kamsarmax "Pedhoulas Commander" 83/2008 Sanoyas, Japan (SS 05/2028, DD 07/2026) at USD 14,7 mill, while the two-years-younger sister vessel "HC Pioneer" 83/2010 Sanoyas, Japan (SS 11/2028, DD 01/2027) was committed a week ago at high USD 17 mill. Moreover, the "The Patron" 79/2010 Jinhai, China (SS 07/2030, DD 03/2029) was committed at low USD 13 mill. Remind you that a month ago, the one-year-younger "Skyros" 79/2011 Nanjing, China (SS/DD 12/2026) was sold at high USD 13 mill. ACBL de Venezuela have committed their Panamax "Panstellar" 76/2003 Imabari, Japan (SS/DD 10/2026) at USD 11 mill. Note that a week ago, the one-year-younger "Prabhu Yuvika" 76/2004 Sumitomo, Japan (SS 07/2029, DD 07/2027) was committed at USD 9,8 mill. Furthermore, Toria Shipmanagement committed their "Kamares" 74/2004 Hudong-Zhonghua, China (SS 08/2029, DD 09/2027) to Chinese interests at USD 8,6 mill. By way of comparison, the "Tailwinds" 73/2004 Jiangnan, China (SS 08/2029, DD 11/2027) was sold in early April at USD 8,5 mill. On the Supramax sector, Byzantine Maritime have committed their "Sety" 55/2010 IHI, Japan (SS 04/2030, DD 01/2028) to Chinese interests at USD 16,5 mill. Remind you that a month ago, the one-year-younger sister vessel "K. Ruby" 55/2011 IHI, Japan (SS/DD 10/2026) was sold at high USD 15 mill. MPP Carriers have committed their Handysizes "Tasan" 38/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS 01/2030, DD 06/2028, Ice Class 1C) & "Captain Ravi" 38/2009 Jiangsu, China (SS 09/2029, DD 02/2028, Ice Class 1C) at USD 10 mill each, while the sister vessel "AP Zaton" 37/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS 02/2030, DD 03/2028, Ice Class 1C) from Tankerska Plovidba was committed at USD 11 mill.
commentary.tankers: The VLCC "Abie" 303/2002 Samsung, Korea (SS 11/2027, DD 07/2026, Scrubber fitted) of High Strong International was committed to undisclosed interests at USD 41 mill. For reference, the three-years-younger "Haishen" 309/2005 Samsung, Korea (SS 10/2028, DD 10/2026, Scrubber fitted) was sold back in March at USD 38 mill. Following the sale of the LR2 "STI Madison" 110/2014 Hyundai Samho, Korea (SS 09/2029, DD 08/2027, Scrubber fitted) three weeks ago at USD 65 mill, Scorpio Tankers have now committed the sister vessel "STI Condotti" 110/2014 Hyundai Samho, Korea (SS 11/2029, DD 11/2027, Scrubber fitted) at USD 70 mill. d'Amico Tankers have committed their MR2 "High Tide" 51/2012 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS/DD 04/2027) to clients of Precious Shipping at USD 28,45 mill. Remind you that back in March, d'Amico sold the sister vessel "High Seas" 50/2012 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS/DD 03/2027) at USD 27,6 mill.

freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: North Pacific rounds with redelivery in the Singapore-Japan range were reported between usd 24,000/26,000 pd. A number of Australian trips from South China into Singapore-Japan range were fixed at levels ranging from usd 23,000/24,000 pd. South East Asian trips to China and Japan were noticed between usd 20,000/24,000 pd. Persian Gulf trips into India were fixed around usd 22,000/23,000 pd. South African trips into Singapore-Japan range were fixed at usd 23,000 pd. East Coast South American trips to Singapore-Japan range were reported at usd 23,000/25,000 pd. North Coast South American trips to Fareast and Singapore-Japan were fixed at levels ranging from usd 20,000/22,000 pd. Continental trips into Far East were fixed at usd 20,000/22,000 pd. On the period front, Kamsarmaxes were reported fixed between usd 20,000/22,000 pd for 12 months.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: South East Asia were reported at a range of usd 14,000/15,000 pd. East Coast Indian trips into China and South East Asia were fixed at usd 15,000/18,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into Japan were fixed at usd 25,000 pd. Continental Trips into Med were reported at usd 18,000 pd.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: China trips into South East Asia, East Coast India and US Gulf were fixed at usd 12,000/15,000 pd. Meanwhile, Japan trips into the West Coast India were reported at usd 20,000/21,000 pd. Continental trips into West Africa were reported at usd 12,000/14,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into China and the Mediterranean were fixed at usd 20,000/22,000 pd. US Gulf trips into North Coast South America were fixed at usd 26,000 pd.
